notes: The TSP100 raster mode of receiptline's stargraphic command set. That set prints images and paper feeds and nothing else: its text, rules and alignment are empty, so the paper holds only the images of the document and the fixture exercises the raster mode wire format, not the layout. No unknown items: ESC RS a and ESC ACK SOH, the print start control and the status request, are parsed since section 16c. Reviewed against receiptline's SVG preview of the same document.
